bmo.line: BMO did the stunt! No double! BMO is the double!

black-mage.line: Thrown like a fireball. Acceptable form.

cat.line: I meant to do that. Cut. Print it.

trump.line: Did my own stunt. No double. Stuntmen are calling me, crying.

buddy-bot.line: Wheee! Trust fall complete. You caught me, right?

bmo.line: Cold pizza for breakfast. So brave. BMO gives it a sticker.

black-mage.line: Cold pizza. Fire-3 would fix it. Fire-3 fixes everything.

cat.line: Pizza. Again. No fish. Two stars, one for the box.

trump.line: Leftover pizza. Very underrated. Some say cold is the best pizza.

buddy-bot.line: Day-two pizza! Bold. Want a buddy to find you a vegetable?

bmo.line: A black stage. One blinking light. BMO is crying. Four stars.

black-mage.line: A hall of endless chatter. Fire-3 would improve it.

cat.line: Rows and rows and not one fish. A slow blink, out of pity.

trump.line: Forty tabs. A tremendous production. Top three, easily.

buddy-bot.line: Tonight's show: your playlist. Track three made me bounce. Encore!

prompts.name: Forecast
prompts.wake: You said: "Three meetings, then the dentist."

bmo.line: Sunny, with a chance of dentist. BMO will hold your hand for the scary part.

black-mage.line: A dark front of meetings, then the dentist. Scattered despair until five.

cat.line: Three meetings. One dentist. Heavy naps expected. Mine, not yours.

trump.line: Big storm of meetings. Then the dentist. Tremendous teeth. Clearing by evening, believe me.

buddy-bot.line: Meetings till noon, then scattered dentist. I'll stroll you to the waiting room.
